title: Project 1 · Update the board count
prompt: Write public static int RemainingAfter(int opening, int arrivals, int completed). Return the number of open tasks after the arrivals are added and the completed tasks are removed. All inputs are whole numbers of 0 or more, and completed is never more than opening plus arrivals. An empty board and a fully completed board both have 0 open tasks.
hints: What would the count be if nobody finished a task?
The completed tasks can come from the opening group or from the new arrivals.
Add opening and arrivals, then subtract completed once.
checkLabels: 3 open, 2 arriving and 1 completed must leave 4.
An empty board must stay at 0.
Completing the opening tasks and the arrivals must leave 0.
With nothing completed, the count is opening plus arrivals.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Adds the completed tasks instead of removing them.

feedback: Work the failing call by hand: start with the opening count, add the arrivals, then take away the completed tasks.
